prompt: Nghiệm dương bé nhất của phương trình <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>sin</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo>cos</mo><mn>23</mn></msup><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>cos</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow></semantics></math> có dạng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi><mi>π</mi></mrow><mi>b</mi></mfrac></semantics></math> với <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>ℤ</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>b</mi><mo>∈</mo><msup><mi>ℕ</mi><mo mathvariant="double-struck">*</mo></msup></mrow></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi></mfrac></semantics></math> là phân số tối giản. solution:
Ta có
sin2x+2cos23x=cos6x⇔sin2x+1+cos6x=cos6x⇔sin2x=−1⇔2x=−π2+k2π,k∈ℤ.⇔x=−π4+kπ,k∈ℤ.
